method: Pearson chi-square test, 1 df, no continuity correction (all expected cells >=5)
effect_name: odds ratio, hypertension versus no hypertension
assumptions: Independent records and mutually exclusive categories; expected-cell rule selects Fisher where needed. Odds-ratio interval is approximate.
question: Is hypertension associated with stroke status?
limitation: Stroke source collection is unverified; cross-sectional association cannot establish temporal or causal direction.
interpretation: At alpha=0.05, reject H0. Observed stroke proportions were 13.25% with hypertension and 3.97% without (difference 9.29%). The odds ratio and its interval describe magnitude; statistical significance alone does not establish clinical importance or causation.

question: Does mean average glucose differ by stroke status?

limitation: Stroke source collection is unverified; skew, outliers and nonrandom sampling limit population inference.
interpretation: At alpha=0.05, reject H0. Mean avg_glucose_level was 132.54 in the positive group (n=249) and 104.80 in the negative group (n=4861); difference 27.75.
